source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: joinChat stores the supplied prplIChatRoomFieldValues on the conversation so reconnect can reuse it. The channel-mode handler now changes only its password value: +k writes the new key and -k writes undefined. Replacing chatRoomFields with a parsed password string would lose the channel and the field-object identity. The current test checks that conversation.chatRoomFields is the exact supplied object and that joinChat returns the same conversation. Command input is sanitized separately from the password. Preserve this mutable field object for reconnect; do not rebuild it from one changed field. This is an IRC state contract, not a rule against replacing objects elsewhere.
title: IRC channel-key changes must preserve the room-field object
